scope: Complete artifact comparison CPU serialized-character selection; repeated two-line deletion synthetic workload; exact packet parity; no model/token/cash/GPU/e2e claims

implementation.procedure: Read entry, lower-bound proof and counter exclusion
implementation.acceptance: Skip only if current target cannot be strictly beaten; preserve all output semantics

reference_boundary.procedure: Frozen f8c92dc baseline differential and independent reconstruction on >=1000 inputs, counted/un-counted modes
reference_boundary.acceptance: Zero packet and restoration mismatches, existing artifact tests pass

data_integrity.procedure: Check frozen source/input/config hashes, fixed seed and seven pairs

numerical_sanity.procedure: Recompute medians and ratio from raw milliseconds
numerical_sanity.acceptance: Finite positive times and matching aggregates

measurement_validity.procedure: Seven alternating complete-entry pairs after warmup
measurement_validity.acceptance: Candidate median <= half baseline on declared workload, identical packet

reproducibility.procedure: Independent subprocess rerun and artifact tests
reproducibility.acceptance: Same parity and performance threshold; boundaries disclosed
